review.summary: Your parses say 90. Your places say 24th on Razorgore, 20th on Firemaw and Flamegor, 21st on Ebonroc and 26th of 29 on Nefarian, about 20th on average. On Chromaggus you took 13 breaths, one fewer than Macharius, who was the one tanking him, and 11k of Ignite Flesh. Vaelastrasz (11th, parse 94) was the one boss where place and parse agreed.

fix.title: Chromaggus
fix.text: 13 breaths and 11k Ignite Flesh. The breath is for the tank.
